sources.supports: Original/OLED no-TV troubleshooting: direct HDMI path, case removal, port/cable/TV/dock comparisons and unresolved console/dock service boundary. Comparison interpretations are identified as leads, not diagnoses.
Illustrated original/OLED dock connections, HAC-002, AC ADAPTER and HDMI OUT labels, orientation, paired controllers, selected TV input and normal console-screen shutdown when docked.
OLED works with original dock; original/OLED system version 11.0.0+ supports LAN dock; Lite cannot use TV mode or docks; dock models and LAN difference.
Original-family supplied-adapter error; disconnect both ends at least 30 seconds; HAC-002; normal three-second Power Options > Restart; current console software and compatible dock.
System Settings > TV Settings; TV Resolution choices Automatic/480p/720p/1080p; consult display manufacturer for supported settings. Original family, not Switch 2 menu.

Only original-family LAN dock HEG-007 updatable; console current first; System > Update Dock > Begin Update. Guide stops if visible prompts cannot be completed, rather than asking owner to navigate blind.

Initial brief LED flash then off normal; solid green during TV display; persistent flash comparison and service, original HAC-007/HEG-007 compatibility. No forced shutdown reproduced for responsive console.
Initialization removes console-memory save data, users and other data; cloud recovery requires existing backups. Consequences only; destructive procedure not reproduced.

Separate Switch 2 procedure: NGN-01, BEE-005 and Ultra High Speed HDMI. HAC-002 may charge directly but cannot support Switch 2 TV mode. No Switch 2 reset sequence mixed into original-family instructions.

decisions: Direct answer and decorative dock-to-TV path, followed by a repeatable direct-HDMI baseline and one-variable comparisons. Interpretations are leads, not physical component diagnoses.
Original-family HAC-002 both-end adapter reset for at least 30 seconds, normal restart, stable-power update and HOME check; handheld failure routes to the existing power guide.
HAC-007 versus HEG-007; original/OLED LAN dock support from version 11.0.0; Lite TV limitation; Switch 2 NGN-01/BEE-005/Ultra High Speed HDMI distinction. No mixed generation reset procedure.
Two native disclosures for Switch 2 and dock firmware. If missing TV image prevents completing firmware prompts, stop rather than navigating blind.
Brief initial LED blink distinguished from persistent flashing. Neither indicator nor a working handheld screen certifies a component.
Save work, avoid interrupted updates, stop for damage/unstable power/forced connectors; no initialization, user deletion or microSD formatting. Initialization save-data loss explained and linked.

Source-based organization attribution; no invented bench testing, business promises, ads, tracking or affiliate placements. Review/publication metadata use October 29; no claim Nintendo updated its documents today.
